name: Tithings
overview: Scripture teaches that tithing is an act of faithful giving that honors God and supports His work, as seen in Malachi 3:10 where the Lord invites His people to bring their tithes into the storehouse and promises abundant blessings in return. However, Jesus in Matthew 23:23 warns against neglecting the more important aspects of the law such as judgment, mercy, and faith while maintaining the practice of tithing, emphasizing that both are essential. Additionally, Luke 6:38 encourages generous giving with the assurance that such generosity will be rewarded manifold, highlighting the principle of reciprocity in God’s provision.
